text: Cooking demands focus and mental flexibility to function as an art form. Roots develop after garlic bulbs are planted, followed by leaf expansion until harvest occurs. Slicing the bulb releases cloves for the pot, while onions frequently remain whole alongside them. Heat applied to oil combined with aromatic compounds generates scents from both onion and garlic; these sensory inputs create a rich flavor profile. Precise heat management paired with ingredient selection yields a complete meal that demonstrates what culinary mastery can achieve. Success depends on three variables: timing, temperature, and taste equilibrium. Ultimately, preparing food should function as an expedition marked by curiosity and surprise.
